nurse.text: Hiya, duck! Welcome to the Nottingham Sanctuary. Pop your team on the counter and I'll take a look.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Sit yourself down, duck. There's a brew on, and a custard cream. Your team's in good hands. Even the Sheriff would say so.
All done, duck. They're fit as a fiddle and twice as shiny. Mind how you go, and mind the lions.
The Ark? It's down in the cellar, duck, in one of the caves. It runs very cool, which is nice. It's also a bit damp.

else.text: No worries, duck. Come back any time. We're open when it rains. Which it does.
